findings.reason: The guard added to the non-unique-claim pass (geometry.py:813-822) is keyed on `m.indices_differential is None`, but its justifying comment reads 'they carry no positioned slot, so a None efm_index can never equal a silop index'. The repair took the second branch of the done-when and kept `efm_index=-1` for a differential mapping, so the sentinel is -1, not None; the comment describes the branch that was not taken. A reader is sent looking for a None efm_index that no mapping carries. The guard is also unreachable as written: fl_claims keys are silop indices from `order[0] >= 0`, and a differential channel never reaches map_amb_sensors (its description has no parseable R,Z and lands in `unmatched`), so no differential mapping is present in `mappings` for the pass to skip. Harmless and defensive, but the stated reason is not the reason it holds.
findings.text: correct the comment to the actual mechanism — the pass only flags positioned claims, so a mapping whose indices_differential is set is skipped — rather than citing a None efm_index the mapping does not carry; or drop the guard as unreachable and say so.

findings.reason: The repair took the done-when's second branch, so a type-6 differential SensorMapping still carries `efm_index=-1`, a value Python reads as the last element of a list. Every consumer named in the done-when is now guarded, and this reviewer found no other indexing consumer in the package: a repo-wide grep of `efm_index` at the reviewed head shows the only list-index write (geometry_adapter.py:809) is behind the new refusal, and every other use is an equality, a dict key, or a mapping construction (the artifact_geometry and transform_geometry_source `efm_index=` sites build positioned EFM matches; scripts/vacuum_loop_adjudication.py:545 uses -1 only for a positioned `nominal:` mapping with indices_differential unset and never indexes by it). But the sentinel class survives, so any consumer added later that indexes by efm_index silently re-opens the overwrite. The choice is spec-compliant and the fragment documents it; recorded as a durability note, not a defect.
findings.text: consider a follow-up that makes the unpositioned state unindexable at the type level (efm_index: int | None with None for differential, or a dedicated not-applicable type), so the guarantee does not rest on every future consumer remembering the indices_differential check.
